name: LCSC Part Importer
description: Search LCSC/JLCPCB parts with photos and place them in the schematic in one click.
description_full:
Search LCSC and JLCPCB parts with photos, symbol/footprint previews, specifications, prices and stock. Parts are imported into an LCSC library via easyeda2kicad and attached to your cursor in the schematic editor. The 'My library' tab filters imported parts by type. English and Turkish UI. Requires the KiCad API (Preferences > Plugins). Windows only for now.

LCSC/JLCPCB parçalarını resimli arayın, tek tıkla şematiğe yerleştirin. Türkçe ve İngilizce arayüz.
